findings.description: The 12 candidate component IDs are proposals; no canonical normative registry binding has been established.

Recursive Git-tree comparison is complete for the two pinned snapshots (115 versus 117 file blobs); generator CI on catalog_commit_sha reproduced 117 scanned files, 342 DETECTED symbols, and 79 explicit exclusions. A bidirectional symbol identity diff has not been run; missing-entry count remains unknown.
Stale, duplicate, and orphan catalog entries have not been exhaustively reconciled against the source tree.
The exact catalog-commit workflow reproduced 79 explicit exclusions, but exclusion-by-exclusion correctness and parser completeness remain unverified.
Source-bound interface and contract mapping is incomplete.
Organization-wide canonical ownership and duplicate-implementation reconciliation has not been run.

limitations: This is a fail-closed initial reconciliation record, not a completed source-to-catalog symbol diff.
comparison_source_file_blobs and catalog_snapshot_file_blobs count tracked file blobs in the two recursive Git trees; source_files_seen is the generator's scanned-file count from the catalog commit.
Null counts mean unknown/not measured; they must not be interpreted as zero.
The 342 symbols and 79 explicit exclusions were reproduced by workflow run 38549057606 at catalog commit 5c27a52e476d6ca10ab3650e7d0370a20e741e70; output status is DETECTED, not VERIFIED.
A RECONCILED status requires complete scope dimensions, zero unresolved blocking findings, and exact-head CI evidence.
decision_rule: Do not mark a candidate VERIFIED based only on file existence or CI success. Preserve BLOCKED/OPEN when source, normative, parser, interface, or ownership evidence is missing.
